title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Unveils New Look At Beloved Characters For a Major Project
content: Isekai series have been gaining more popularity in recent years, and among them, Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World stands out as one of the best in the industry. The series often stands out for its dark themes and unique plot, especially among Crunchyroll anime.
author: ComicBook

title: MVM Will Release Ya Boy Kongming! Collector's Blu-ray on November 9
content: MVM has announced on its X/Twitter feed that it will release a Collector's Blu-ray of the first TV season of Ya Boy Kongming! ( Paripi Kōmei ) on November 9. The Blu-ray will include a 64-page booklet.
author: ANN

title: Upcoming Talks On Studio Ghibli in Exeter and Leicester
content: The author Helen McCarthy will deliver lectures on "The Art History of Studio Ghibli " at at the Exeter Phoenix on Tuesday September 1 at 7.30 p.m., doors open 7 p.m. ( tickets ); and at the Sue Townsend Theatre in Leicester on Monday February Monday October 5 at 7.30 p.m., doors open 7 p.m. ( tickets ).
author: ANN

title: Gurren Lagann UK Collectors Blu-rays Released on Monday
content: The two Gurren Lagann feature films are Gurren Lagann the Movie –Childhood's End- , (compiled from the 15 TV episodes with some new footage) and Gurren Lagann the Movie – The Lights in the Sky Are Stars (a sequel to the series).
author: ANN

title: Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu Stop-Motion Series' Trailer Streams in India
content: The official Pokémon YouTube channel began streaming the trailer for Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu , the franchise 's stop-motion animated series collaboration with independent studio Aardman ( Wallace & Gromit , Shaun the Sheep ), on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dubs of Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4, 'Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun' Season 3 Stream on Muse India
content: The new season of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime debuted on April 3 on NTV 's now one-hour "Friday Anime Night" programming block, at 11:00 p.m. JST. The new season started airing on BS11 on April 4 at 10:00 p.m. JST and on other streaming services at 11:00 p.m. JST.
author: ANN

title: 'Ao Ashi Season 2' Unveils Additional Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for the Ao Ashi television anime series unveiled additional staff, and the first promotional video on Tuesday. The anime sequel adapting Yuugo Kobayashi 's sports manga is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 5:00 p.m. on NHK-E.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'With You, Our Love Will Make it Through' Manga Ends in 13th Volume
content: Chihiro Yuzuki announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that her With You, Our Love Will Make it Through ( Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ) manga will end with the 13th compiled book volume.
author: ANN

title: Aoashi Season 2 Main Trailer Previews Theme Song, October 4 Premiere Revealed
content: The upcoming second season of AOASHI has unveiled its main trailer, featuring the new theme songs ahead of the anime’s October 4 premiere. Studio TMS Entertainment was previously confirmed to be taking over from Production I.G for the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: Toshiko Machida's Hanako-gari Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's Pocket Magazine platform published the final chapter of Toshiko Machida 's Hanako-gari (Hanako Hunt) manga on August 27. The story is set in a world where spirits run rampant.
author: ANN
